from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The repeated grid-line color is the most common color other than the fill.
    structural = max((c for c in counts if c != background), key=lambda c: counts[c])
    # Grid lines run through most of the corresponding axis; signal colors only
    # replace occasional intersections.
    xs = [x for x in range(w) if sum(grid[y][x] == structural for y in range(h)) >= 0.65*h]
    ys = [y for y in range(h) if sum(v == structural for v in grid[y]) >= 0.65*w]
    # Some diagrams omit the final horizontal segment but retain its marked
    # intersections at the bottom edge.
    if len(ys) >= 2 and ys[-1] < h-1 and 0.7*(ys[-1]-ys[-2]) <= h-1-ys[-1] <= 1.3*(ys[-1]-ys[-2]):
        if xs and all(grid[h-1][x] != background for x in xs):
            ys.append(h-1)
    out=[]
    for r in range(len(ys)-1):
        row=[]
        for c in range(len(xs)-1):
            corners=(grid[ys[r]][xs[c]], grid[ys[r]][xs[c+1]],
                     grid[ys[r+1]][xs[c]], grid[ys[r+1]][xs[c+1]])
            colors=[v for v in corners if v != background and v != structural]
            row.append(colors[0] if colors and all(v == colors[0] for v in colors) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
